svg.text: Figure B. End-to-end SlotSmith architecture (what the code does today)
Solid boxes are implemented in src/slotsmith or app/. Amber = independent verification. Dashed = conditional or planned. Files are blue.
read by validate, allocate, revise, repair and verify: hardware table, capacities, spare %, naming patterns, rule switches
Lane 1 Initial allocation: pipeline.run() (used by the CLI and by the Streamlit 'Allocate' button)
Lane 2 Revision: revision.revise() (CLI 'revise' and the Streamlit 'Compare and re-allocate' button)
conditional: window of cabinets, 10 s per solve
Surfaces, data generation and evidence (they call the engine; the engine never imports them)
LLM suggestion helper for column mapping and rule drafts · exporter for the official allocation template (not released) · Docker demo bundle
Row provenance (file:sheet:row) travels with every signal into the TQ list and the 'Source' column of the workbook.
